requests.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one full-screen background drawing for a connected four-screen 2D storybook Opera House game. The attached original Opera foyer is a STYLE AND ARCHITECTURAL IDENTITY reference only. Preserve its warm coral-peach walls, ivory seashell mouldings, antique gold details, muted teal upholstery and polished painterly storybook craft. Create a new spacious single-level room, straight-on theatrical side view, landscape 16:9. Wall/floor junction at 60% image height; broad clear walkable floor across the lower 40%, same perspective as the reference. Keep three large quiet blank wall bays centered at 27%, 50%, 73% across, from 25% to 60% height: runtime will place separate arched door cards and crests there. DO NOT paint any doors, badges, symbols or sconces into those three bays. Peripheral scenery stays behind the walking band or at the far edges. Continue the room sideways through open left/right edges, no opaque side wall blocking traversal. No figures, people, animals, words, numbers, HUD or map. No chandelier: a separate animated one will be staged later. Highest possible native detail, 3840x2160 requested; never include a collage, panels, gutters or frame. This is one distinct room drawing, not a repeated copy of the original three-floor foyer. Southwest quadrant: the welcoming arrival lounge. At the far-left back corner a beautiful small pearl-shell water fountain with still pale turquoise basin, at far right a low curved coral velvet conversation sofa and small side table. Broad salmon terrazzo floor with a small shell inlay, calm seafoam accents, warm sunny glow. A generous cream stair landing tucked at far left signals the upper costume gallery; don't obstruct the three blank bays.
